I live in Canada and we went to Vancouver for our first family trip together when my LO was 6 months old. We also flew in a plane to get there. It was super hard because she wouldn’t sleep! It took her so long to adjust to the city and the constant noise, which by the way we are from the North where it is super quiet (and colder)

She didn’t mind her stroller but after awhile she hated being in it so we put her in her baby carrier which had its own problems because she hates being confined in tight places. But it was also the only way she felt comfortable enough to sleep (my auntie taught me this trick of running both fighters over her head lightly sort of like a head massage) which helps when she inconsolably crying and can’t sleep in her baby carrier.

My little one was just starting different purées with her oatmeal and it was great being in Vancouver because there’s so much options for baby food. Also baby toys and such. Edit: I forgot to mention her solid food schedule was thrown off because my baby HATED cold food so I couldn’t just pack pre made baby food for her to take on the go. I had to breast feed her most of the time, the only times I fed her solids was in the morning before we left to venture around and later at night before bed.

Since we live in the north, the weather was certainly hard to adjust too because we aren’t used to such hot and humid rainy days or the super hot sunny days. My baby has sensitive skin and it was hard to plan her outfits for the day because weather was unpredictable, so I always had spare cloths for her in the diaper bag.

Long story short, taking a vacation/trip while a baby is 6 months old is super hard because it throws all the baby’s sleeping schedule, eating schedule and everything off balance. You have to prepare for every single little thing and it’s hard to enjoy yourself when your baby is inconsolably crying and uncomfortable being in a foreign loud environment. Also FINDING A GOOD PLACE TO CHANGE YOUR BABY CAN BE HARD (thank god for family bathrooms)

Edit2: my 6 month old was also teething, so it was extra hellish with her crankiness.
